title: Former Chestnut Market CEO joins retail tech firm’s C-suite
excerpt: Bridgera, a software and tech company that focuses on maintenance and systems upkeep, has hired Ryan Oettinger as chief revenue officer as it focuses on the...
content_html:
Jessica Loder

Tue, August 11, 2026 at 5:09 AM EDT 2 min read

This story was originally published on C-Store Dive. To receive daily news and insights, subscribe to our free daily C-Store Dive newsletter.

Bridgera, a company focused on streamlining and improving operational technology, has hired convenience retail industry veteran Ryan Oettinger as chief revenue officer, according to a Tuesday announcement. 

Oettinger brings a wealth of experience with both convenience retailers and technology companies, including well over a decade at Chevron and several years at Pilot Company, as well as a stint with Vontier's Gilbarco Veeder-Root subsidiary. Most recently, he was named CEO of Chestnut Market in January before resigning from the East Coast c-store retailer three months later.

In his new role, Oettinger will oversee revenue-generating functions at Bridgera, including sales, marketing and business development, he said in an interview with C-Store Dive. He took the role on June 1.

Oettinger said his experience in convenience and fuel retail should help Bridgera understand the industry's customer base as the company moves more into the space. 

"Having someone that really understands what convenience retailers and petroleum marketers and fuel equipment distributors are looking for, what their pain points and headaches are and how we can actually solve those in a fairly quick and disciplined and cost-effective manner with technology, is important," said Oettinger.

Bridgera's technology links any connected systems a business may have, like fuel pumps, coolers, food warmers, point of sale systems, to its proprietary AI agents, Oettinger said. The agent can not only alert the retailer to any potential problems, but also to take action to address some of those problems before they impact operations. 

The system can address an estimated 70%-80% of routine operational decisions while keeping people in control of higher-risk exceptions, according to the press release. 

Convenience retail companies are delving more into AI solutions across multiple store and forecourt functions. This year, the industry has seen Loop Neighborhood Market deploy an AI assistant, Urban Value Corner Store expand its AI-powered coolers and Casey's General Stores expand the rollout of automated ordering agents.

这个故事最初发表在 C-Store Dive 上。 要接收每日新闻和见解，请订阅我们免费的每日 C-Store Dive 时事通讯。

根据周二的公告，Bridgera 是一家专注于简化和改进运营技术的公司，已聘请便利零售行业资深人士 Ryan Oettinger 担任首席营收官。

Oettinger 拥有在便利零售商和科技公司工作的丰富经验，其中包括在雪佛龙 (Chevron) 工作十多年、在 Pilot Company 工作数年，以及在 Vontier 的 Gilbarco Veeder-Root 子公司工作过的经历。 最近，他于一月份被任命为 Chestnut Market 首席执行官，三个月后从这家东海岸便利店零售商辞职。

Oettinger 在接受 C-Store Dive 采访时表示，在新职位上，Oettinger 将监督 Bridgera 的创收职能，包括销售、营销和业务开发。 他于 6 月 1 日上任。

奥廷格表示，随着公司更多地进军该领域，他在便利和燃料零售方面的经验应该有助于布里格拉了解该行业的客户群。

“拥有真正了解便利零售商、石油营销商和燃料设备分销商正在寻找什么、他们的痛点和头痛是什么以及我们如何利用技术以相当快速、规范和具有成本效益的方式真正解决这些问题的人非常重要，”奥廷格说。

Oettinger 表示，Bridgera 的技术将企业可能拥有的任何互联系统（例如燃油泵、冷却器、食品加热器、销售点系统）与其专有的人工智能代理连接起来。 代理商不仅可以提醒零售商任何潜在的问题，还可以在其中一些问题影响运营之前采取行动解决它们。

据新闻稿称，该系统可以解决估计 70%-80% 的日常运营决策，同时让人们控制高风险的异常情况。

便利零售公司正在更多地研究跨多个商店和前院功能的人工智能解决方案。 今年，业界看到 Loop Neighborhood Market 部署了人工智能助手，Urban Value Corner Store 扩大了人工智能冷却器，Casey's General Stores 扩大了自动订购代理的部署。
